root_cause: The radios component only updates conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven changes, so selecting a different radio via arrow keys leaves the previously shown conditional field visible.
repair_strategy: Add a change event listener to the radios module and a handler that updates aria-expanded and toggles the conditional content for the changed radio when it has aria-controls, ensuring keyboard selection updates the UI.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation will correctly show/hide conditional fields, ensuring that the appropriate conditional content is hidden when a different radio is selected, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 2.4.3 (Focus Order).
functional_risks: Potential duplicate handling if both click and change events fire for the same interaction, but setAttributes is idempotent.
If another script also listens for change events on the same radios, there could be unintended side effects, though the change event is standard and unlikely to conflict.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing ArrowDown from the email radio to the text radio hides the email input and shows the mobile number input.
Verify that pressing ArrowDown from the text radio to the opt‑out radio hides the mobile number input.
Verify that mouse clicks still correctly show/hide the associated conditional fields.
Verify that the aria‑expanded attribute on each radio reflects its checked state after keyboard selection.
